label: The spread of the difference
subgoals: Square both sigmas and subtract twice the correlation times their product
Take the square root to get theta
Divide the difference of the means by theta to get alpha

label: The tightness probability
subgoals: Evaluate the standard normal distribution at alpha
Read the result as the probability that A is the later arrival

label: The mean of the max
subgoals: Weight each input mean by its tightness probability
Add theta times the normal density at alpha
Compare the result with the larger input mean
